title: CJP accuses govt of suppressing youth-led movement

ai.summary: Cockroach Janta Party leader Saurav Das accused the government of suppressing a youth-led movement by blocking travel, restricting protests and censoring social media, claiming Meta deleted 60 lakh posts and prevented leaders from speaking at international events.

facts.claim: Cockroach Janta Party leader Saurav Das accused the government of suppressing a youth-led movement
facts.quote: Cockroach Janta Party co-convener Saurav Das on Tuesday accused the government of being afraid of the youth-led movement
Das’ remarks came a day after he was allegedly stopped from travelling to the UK to attend an event at the University of Oxford
We were stopped from going to Jantar Mantar, we were stopped from going to Ramlila Maidan
Claiming large-scale censorship on social media, he alleged that Meta had deleted 60 lakh posts over the past few months

ai.background_note: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) is a youth-led movement that has been active in India, with claims of government suppression through travel restrictions, protest bans, and social media censorship.
